title: Nourishing Mexican Chicken Tinga
description: A fresh and crunchy Mexican dish featuring dried oregano, perfect for a healthy and energizing meal.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, grill the onion and garlic for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Once the chicken is cooked, chop it into small pieces and add it to a bowl with the grilled onion and garlic.
Add the chipotle peppers and adobo sauce to the bowl and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the chicken tinga hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
